personal_thread_revision.olive_oil: Author requested company anonymity and described 2026 failure after US tariffs, fuel-related freight and fulfillment last-mile costs, premium pricing/tight margins, sustained cost-reduction efforts and an advertising burden linked to establishing quality. Personal cost/failure accounts are not independently audited. No specific competitor is accused. No claim that most oil is adulterated, honest businesses cannot scale, or enforcement does not exist is made. Current local production/relationships are an orientation; no new product or customer is invented.
personal_thread_revision.conceptual_boundary: Life regret and missed wealth explain motivation, not an empirical proof of finite comparison budgets or a policy entitlement. Olive-oil quality uncertainty is linked to Akerlof before returning to contribution uncertainty that can remain with known quality.
